ny.method: IT-203 part-year method: all income received during the resident period (Jan 1 - Jun 30, 181 days) plus New York source income during the nonresident period (Jul 1 - Dec 31, 184 days). Marcus's post-move wages are NY source under the convenience-of-the-employer rule (NY employer; remote work for his own convenience after the family's voluntary move to Tampa). Elena's post-move wages are not NY source because her employer permitted her to work fully remote (not at her own convenience), so only the resident-period portion of her wages is NY source: $54,000 x 181/365 = $26,778.
